title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 (SSVEP) — Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms
description: A multimodal SSVEP dataset from 31 healthy participants, recorded with 64-channel EEG plus EOG, with up to three sessions per subject. Participants viewed flickering LED stimuli in a 4-class frequency paradigm (48 trials per session, 3024 trials in total). It is part of a larger collection combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms, and is distributed here in a MOABB-derived BIDS format.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a Neuroscan Quik-Cap 65-channel cap and SynAmps2 amplifier (Ag/AgCl sensors, right mastoid reference, forehead ground, 50 Hz line frequency). Participants viewed flickering LED stimuli in a 4-class SSVEP paradigm, with 48 trials per session and up to 3 sessions per subject. Trial duration was 7 s, and the analysis interval was 0-5 s.
